about: The points on the page's map of gated neighborhoods, north to south, one numbered marker each. A map of many places shows 15 at most (tools/area-map.js), so four pairs of neighbors that share a road share a marker. Points are the average position of the community's home address points (Horry County) or home parcel centers (Georgetown County) from gated-communities.json; a pair is the midpoint of its two points (each pair is under 1.5 km apart).

prices.about: The price chart: the middle recorded sale (Horry County deed records, deeds recorded October 2025 through September 2026, builder sales left out) for each gated neighborhood whose verified row allows a typical price, rounded as the page says it. Neighborhoods with only a range (Seaside Plantation, Leatherleaf, The Bluffs on the Waterway) or no verified price are not charted.
